title: Apply for the Recovery Grant for Small Businesses and Non-Profit Organisations
summary: Find out if you are eligible for a grant of up to $25,000 to help small businesses and non-profit organisations recover from severe weather damage.
intro:
If you’re a small business or non-profit organisation impacted by recent severe weather events, you may be eligible for a grant to help with the costs of clean-up, repairs and reopening.

A grant of up to $25,000 is available to eligible small businesses and non-profit organisations in impacted Local Government Areas (LGAs) that suffered direct damage as a result of:

Refer to the Guidelines for more information on what can and cannot be claimed.
who_can_apply: Must be a small business or non-profit organisation operating in an impacted LGA listed under AGRN 1212 or AGRN 1198.
Must have suffered direct damage as a result of NSW East Coast Severe Weather from 18 May 2025, or Tropical Cyclone Alfred Severe Weather from 3 March 2025.
Must have an active Australian Business Number (ABN) and have held that ABN at the time of the disaster.
Must intend to re-establish operations within the same area.
Must not be fully insured and claiming all recovery costs through insurance.
Must not have already received a government grant under AGRN 1212 or AGRN 1198.
Must employ up to 20 full-time staff or equivalent, and not be part of a national chain, OR be a sole trader receiving at least 50% of your income from the business.

If a non-profit, must be registered with the Australian Charities and Not-for-profits Commission or an equivalent body, or be a company limited by guarantee that is not established or operated for profit.
Must not receive 50% or more of income from primary production activities unless they involve specific activities.
Must not be included on the National Redress Scheme's website on the list of 'Institutions that have not joined or signified their intent to join the Scheme'.
what_you_need: Your valid ABN/ACN number (ensure details are up to date on the Australian Business Register).
Australian bank account details for payment.
A rates notice or lease agreement to show that the business was operating in an impacted LGA.
Evidence of payment, including details of your business insurance if you have it.
A letter of authority if you are not the business owner.
All documents and photos must be ready to be uploaded in JPG, PDF, PNG, or TIF format.

faqs.q: What costs are covered by the grant?
faqs.a: Covered costs include, but are not limited to, clean-up and repairs following direct damage from severe weather events.

faqs.q: Who can apply for this grant?
faqs.a: You must be a small business or non-profit organisation that suffered direct damage in an impacted LGA and meet specific criteria, such as having an active ABN and not being fully insured.
